Global Immersion & International Exposure Students will receive exposure to global learning environments, international projects, and future overseas study opportunities. Key Benefits The programme equips students with DevOps, Cloud Engineering, and AI-driven automation—the three most in-demand skill clusters globally. Students gain hands-on experience through project sprints every semester and capstone projects. Learners graduate with readymade industry portfolios, global micro-credentials, and job-ready competencies. Students receive continuous industry mentorship, exposure to enterprise tools, and readiness for certifications (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, DevOps Institute).

Blockchain & CBDCs DeFi, smart contracts, Digital Rupee vs Yuan 5 Hours 5. AI & Big Data Credit scoring, risk modeling, AI-based analysis 5 Hours 6. RegTech & Cybersecurity KYC, AML, data privacy, anomaly detection 5 Hours Capstone Project Build a FinTech solution 10 Hours 2. Programming for Fintech (Python, R, Java) Overview: Automate financial workflows—data scraping, portfolio optimization, and risk calculations. Python & R Basics: Pandas, dplyr, financial datasets Web Scraping: BeautifulSoup, Selenium, APIs Portfolio Optimization: Python & R implementation Risk Calculations: VaR, Monte Carlo simulations Capstone Project 3. Data Analytics & Visualization in Finance Financial data cleaning & preprocessing Statistical techniques & time series Machine learning (Regression, Trees, SVM) Fraud detection & predictive modeling Visualization tools: Tableau, Power BI Capstone Project 4. Blockchain Development & Smart Contracts Blockchain fundamentals (Ethereum, Hyperledger) Smart contracts with Solidity DApp development Use cases: payments, land registry, supply chain
